---
name: Suggest a new task definition
about: Propose a new task to be added to the development or held-out split
title: "[TASK] "
labels: enhancement, task
assignees: ''

---

**Task Title & Description**
A clear description of the user goal (e.g., "Export paint canvas to PNG and copy path").

**Category**
Select from: `calculator`, `text_editor`, `file_manager`, `graphics`, `browser`, `multi_app`, `settings`, `task_manager`

**Target Applications**
Which Windows applications are required (e.g., `mspaint.exe`, `notepad.exe`)?

**Proposed Success Criteria**
List the conditions that define success (e.g., file exists at `%USERPROFILE%\Desktop\canvas.png` and contains specific image dimensions).

**Chaos Compatibility**
Which chaos disruptions are safe to run during this task (e.g., popup, resize, delay)?
